profile.research_note: [batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] This is the Advanced Operations Center, a 34,000 gross square foot data infrastructure facility under construction on the University of Minnesota Twin Cities East Bank campus in Minneapolis, Hennepin County, at the north end of parking lot C33 northwest of Huntington Bank Stadium. The university own capital project management office describes 12,000 square feet of network and data hall space plus supporting areas, at a total project budget of 72.75 million dollars. Construction began August 2024 with DLR Group as architect and McGough Construction as general contractor, with completion projected around August 2026. The project is intended to modernize and consolidate the university core network operations infrastructure, serving the university own IT and network operations rather than offering commercial colocation. Because this research was conducted close to the facility planned 2026 completion date, its final operational status was not independently confirmed. This research was carried out at the operator level in an earlier phase of this project.
